minutes.headline: Finance Committee heard FY17 DPW and Land Use budget reviews; budgets level-funded, only adjournment voted.
minutes.summary: The committee continued department budget reviews. The DPW director described a level-funded balanced budget with no cushion for unexpected costs, unfunded mandates such as stormwater, and unmet road funding needs. The land use director presented above-target Conservation Commission requests and a combined conservation administrator position. A Monty Tech assessment increase was reported, and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the DPW director describe a level-funded, balanced FY17 budget with no cushion for unexpected costs.
The DPW director said a revised pavement plan shows a large road repair shortfall, and a new stormwater permit is an unfunded mandate with no funding source.
The land use director presented above-target Conservation Commission requests, described as unlikely to be funded, and a combined conservation administrator position.
The town manager reported the Monty Tech assessment is above the required minimum because of higher enrollment.
No budget was voted; the only vote was to adjourn, and the next meeting is a special session with the library and schools.

why_it_matters: Level-funded departments leave little room for storms, repairs or new state requirements, so road and stormwater needs may return as requests for added money that residents could be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
The Monty Tech assessment is set partly by enrollment, so it can rise the town's cost for that school without any change in town spending choices.

Regular meeting on March 10th with Monty Tech.
